questions.statement: Which words are furniture and objects of the house?
questions.context: In a house in Duitama, rooms have a bed, a stove and a shower.

options.feedback: Lion, tiger and bear are animals, not house objects.
Car, moto and bike are transport, not house objects.
Mango, rice and soup are foods, not furniture.
Bed, stove and shower are all objects found in a house.

questions.explanation: Esta pregunta presenta vocabulario básico de la casa en inglés. También se conecta cada objeto con habitaciones de un hogar boyacense.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: In Envigado, a mother says: "We cook in the kitchen. We sleep in the bedroom. We wash in the bathroom."

options.feedback: A country is a nation, not a part of a house.

options.text: A part of the house with its own use.
options.feedback: A room is a separate space like the kitchen or bedroom.
Animals are living beings, not parts of a house.
Instruments make music and are not parts of a house.

questions.explanation: La palabra room significa cada espacio de la casa con su uso propio. También se comprende con la cocina, la alcoba y el baño.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct preposition to complete the sentence.
questions.context: In Facatativá, a girl says: "The cat is _____ the table and the chairs."

options.feedback: "Between" shows the cat is in the middle of the two objects.
"Behinds" is not a correct English word.
"Underneaths" is not a correct English word.
"Nexts" is not a correct English word.

questions.explanation: La preposición between ubica algo en medio de dos objetos. También se practica con el gato entre la mesa y las sillas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: In Chía, students read: "My house has three bedrooms. The kitchen is next to the living room. The garden is behind the house."

options.feedback: The kitchen is next to the living room, not the garden.
The bedrooms are rooms inside, not the garden.
The text says the garden is behind the house.
The text never mentions the roof of the house.

questions.explanation: Leer descripciones exige ubicar cada espacio con su preposición exacta. También se aplica con una casa familiar en Chía.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which word means the opposite of wet?
questions.context: At home in Girardot, a boy helps: "Put the hot soup on the table. Hang the wet towel in the bathroom."

options.feedback: Cold is the opposite of hot, not of wet.
Dry is the opposite of wet and describes the clean towel.
Dirty is the opposite of clean, not of wet.
Small is the opposite of big, not of wet.

questions.explanation: Los opuestos como wet y dry describen estados de los objetos del hogar. También se asocian con tareas que ayudan los niños en Girardot.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What can you conclude about the two homes?
questions.context: In Sogamoso, two ads appear: "Small apartment: one bedroom, no garden, near the school" and "Big farm: four bedrooms, garden with fruits, far from the school."

options.text: Both homes have gardens with fruits.
options.feedback: Only the farm has a garden with fruits.

options.text: Size, garden and distance change between them.
options.feedback: The ads contrast bedrooms, garden and distance to school.

options.text: Both homes are near the school.
options.feedback: Only the apartment is near the school; the farm is far.
The apartment has one bedroom and the farm has four.

questions.explanation: Analizar avisos permite comparar tamaño, jardín y distancia. También se trabaja la lectura comparativa de dos viviendas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: In Ipiales, a teacher compares: "There is a lamp in the room" and "There are two lamps in the room."

options.text: Both sentences talk about two lamps.
options.feedback: Only the second sentence mentions two lamps.

options.text: The first shows one object, the second shows many.
options.feedback: "There is" introduces singular and "there are" introduces plural.

options.text: Both sentences talk about the past.
options.feedback: Both sentences use the present forms is and are.

options.text: The first shows many objects, the second shows one.
options.feedback: The roles are reversed; is is singular and are is plural.

questions.explanation: There is presenta singular y there are presenta plural. También se practica con lámparas de una habitación en Ipiales.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which drawing is the best for fifth graders?
questions.context: In Tumaco, two house drawings for a class project appear: one labels every room and object in English; the other has no labels and mixes kitchen objects in the bathroom.

options.text: The drawing with English labels in each room.
options.feedback: Labels in English teach the vocabulary of every room and object.

options.text: The drawing with kitchen objects in the bathroom.
options.feedback: Mixed objects confuse learners and teach wrong places.

options.text: The drawing with no labels at all.
options.feedback: A drawing without labels teaches no English vocabulary.

options.text: Both drawings are equal for learning.
options.feedback: The drawings are very different; only one teaches vocabulary.

questions.explanation: Evaluar dibujos implica revisar etiquetas correctas y orden por habitación. También se promueve rotular la propia casa en inglés.
questions.subject: ingles
